---
name: Bug report
about: Something doesn't work or looks/sounds different from the original
title: ''
labels: bug
---

**What happened?**
A short description, and what you expected instead.

**Where in the game?**
E.g. "Luxor, after going down the ladder and the slopes, talking to the old lady".

**System**
macOS / Windows / Linux / Steam Deck / Switch, and the version (shown on the release you downloaded).

**Session recording (please attach)**
Reproduce the problem, quit the game, and attach `session.llrec` from the data folder
(zip it if GitHub refuses the file):
- macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/LaserLords/LaserLords/`
- Linux / Steam Deck: `~/.local/share/LaserLords/LaserLords/`
- Windows: `%APPDATA%\LaserLords\LaserLords\`
- Switch: `sdmc:/switch/laserlords/`

It contains only your controller/keyboard input, no game data, and lets the session be
replayed exactly.

Please don't attach disc images, ROMs or other game files.
